version: 1
kind: interface_manifest
project_id: group_run
source_prd: "PRD: group_run (1-Hour Cycle MVP+) v0.5"
stack: fullstack_fastapi_react
scope: >
  Full-stack CRUD for group run events with participant join/leave via an
  in-memory store. Deliberately excludes authentication, persistent database,
  real-time updates, external service integration, and UI component libraries.

entities:
  - name: Run
    fields:
      - { name: id,                type: string,  required: true,  generated: true }
      - { name: title,             type: string,  required: true }
      - { name: datetime,          type: string,  required: true }
      - { name: location,          type: string,  required: true }
      - { name: distance,          type: string,  required: false }
      - { name: pace,              type: string,  required: false }
      - { name: notes,             type: string,  required: false }
      - { name: participants,      type: "list[string]", required: true, default: [] }
      - { name: participant_count, type: integer, required: true }

api:
  base_path: /api
  request_shapes:
    RunCreate:
      required: [title, datetime, location]
      optional: [distance, pace, notes]
    JoinIn:
      required: [name]
    LeaveIn:
      required: [name]
  endpoints:
    - method: POST
      path: /runs
      summary: create a new run event
      request: RunCreate
      response: Run
      success_status: 201
      errors: [validation_error]
    - method: GET
      path: /runs
      summary: list all runs
      response: "list[Run]"
    - method: GET
      path: "/runs/{run_id}"
      summary: get run details and participants
      response: Run
      errors: [run_not_found]
    - method: POST
      path: "/runs/{run_id}/join"
      summary: join a run with a participant name
      request: JoinIn
      response: Run
      errors: [validation_error, run_not_found, duplicate_participant]
    - method: POST
      path: "/runs/{run_id}/leave"
      summary: remove a participant from a run by name
      request: LeaveIn
      response: Run
      errors: [validation_error, run_not_found, participant_not_found]
  error_contract:
    shape: '{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}'
    codes:
      validation_error:       { http: 422 }
      run_not_found:          { http: 404 }
      duplicate_participant:  { http: 409 }
      participant_not_found:  { http: 404 }

frontend:
  framework: react_vite
  routes:
    - path: /
      view: RunListView
      purpose: display list of runs with title, datetime, location, participant count; link to create and detail
      testids:
        - run-list-view
        - run-list
        - run-row
        - create-run-link
        - empty-state
    - path: /runs/new
      view: RunCreateView
      purpose: form to create a run with required and optional fields; redirect to list on success
      testids:
        - run-create-view
        - run-create-form
        - run-create-title
        - run-create-datetime
        - run-create-location
        - run-create-distance
        - run-create-pace
        - run-create-notes
        - run-create-submit
        - run-create-error
    - path: /runs/:run_id
      view: RunDetailView
      purpose: show run details, participant list, join form, and leave form
      testids:
        - run-detail-view
        - run-detail-title
        - run-detail-participants
        - run-detail-participant
        - run-detail-participant-count
        - run-detail-join-form
        - run-detail-join-name
        - run-detail-join-submit
        - run-detail-leave-form
        - run-detail-leave-name
        - run-detail-leave-submit
        - run-detail-error
        - run-detail-not-found

persistence: in_memory

decisions:
  - id: duplicate-name-case-sensitivity
    choice: "Participant name uniqueness is case-insensitive (\"Alice\" and \"alice\" are the same participant)"
    warrant: "PRD §5.4 — 'default recommendation: case-insensitive uniqueness'"
  - id: leave-unknown-participant
    choice: "Leaving a run with a name not on the run returns 404 PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND"
    warrant: "PRD §5.5 — 'backend returns clear error'; 404 is the natural semantic for a missing resource"
  - id: datetime-storage
    choice: "The datetime field is stored and returned as an opaque string; no server-side parsing or validation of format"
    warrant: "PRD §5.1 — 'string input acceptable for MVP'; sorting is expansion scope (§4.1 T1.2)"
  - id: run-id-generation
    choice: "Run id is a UUID string generated server-side at creation"
    warrant: "PRD §5.1 — 'created run with generated id'; UUID avoids counter state in the in-memory store"
  - id: participant-count-derivation
    choice: "participant_count is derived as len(participants) in the response; not independently stored"
    warrant: "PRD §5.2 and §5.3 require displaying participant count; including it in the response avoids client-side array-length computation in three views"
  - id: leave-via-post-body
    choice: "Leave uses POST /runs/{run_id}/leave with a JSON body {name} rather than DELETE with the name in the URL path"
    warrant: "Technical design §2.2; avoids URL-encoding issues with names containing spaces or special characters; keeps the request shape symmetric with join"
